building.title: Fine Arts Studio Block 431 (431), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 431's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 431 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above 3 m over the provisional ground (33.16 m, the median LiDAR ground within the outline's band, as the measured massing took it); the centre from the same points (tower_above), which lie within 1.5 m of the campus map ring. The walls' axis runs along the block's long faces (bearing 252.6 deg), so z faces south-south-east (bearing 162.6 deg), to the lane and its car park, which the photograph looks along
